sections.heading: Reliable Dirt & Gravel Delivery for Any Project
sections.body: Bellhouse Excavating delivers bulk aggregate to farms, rural properties, and construction sites across Brant County and Brantford — from standard driveway gravel and topsoil to multi-load aggregate deliveries for lane prep, drainage work, and pad construction. When aggregate needs to be moved and placed across a farm field, soft area, or rough terrain that a road truck can't safely travel, Bellhouse brings in a Volvo A35 articulated off-road machine to handle on-site material movement after tri-axle trucks deliver to the site. Material type, quantity, access conditions, and where the load needs to land are all reviewed before delivery is scheduled.

sections.heading: The Volvo A35 places material where standard dump trucks stop.
sections.body:
Tri-axle road trucks are how aggregate gets to your site — they're built for road hauling and efficient at it. But they stop at the edge of a farm field, a soft area, or rough terrain. The load lands at the nearest accessible point, and moving it the rest of the way becomes your problem.

Bellhouse operates a Volvo A35 articulated off-road machine to close that gap. Once tri-axle trucks deliver aggregate to the site, the A35 moves and places material across farm fields, unimproved terrain, soft ground, and locations a road truck can't safely reach. If the gravel needs to end up somewhere a tri-axle would turn around, the A35 gets it there.

items.question: What materials do you deliver?
items.answer: Bellhouse can deliver gravel, sand, topsoil, fill, and other aggregates depending on the project and material availability.

items.question: Is there a minimum order?
items.answer: Most deliveries require at least one full dump truck load. If you are unsure about quantity, Bellhouse can review the material, location, and rough dimensions before scheduling.

items.question: Can you dump material exactly where I need it?
items.answer: We place material where truck access, overhead clearance, ground conditions, and safety allow. The best dump location is confirmed before delivery whenever possible.

items.question: Can delivery be coordinated with grading or excavation work?
items.answer: Yes. Bellhouse can coordinate material delivery with driveway prep, grading, drainage, excavation, or contractor-led site work when those scopes are part of the job.

items.question: Can you place gravel across a wet or soft farm field?
items.answer: Yes, with a two-step approach. Tri-axle trucks deliver aggregate to the site or a staging point. The Bellhouse Volvo A35 — an articulated off-road machine — then moves and places that material across the farm field, soft ground, or rough terrain that a road truck can't safely travel. Most contractors stop at the field edge; the A35 gets material to the final location.

items.question: Do you deliver to farm properties and rural sites?
items.answer: Yes. Farm lanes, rural property pads, and drainage areas across Brant County are standard work. Tri-axle trucks handle the road delivery to your property. For locations across the site that a road truck can't safely reach — fields, soft ground, rough terrain — the Volvo A35 handles the on-site material movement.
